interpretation: The lack of cross-survey Shark Rock recovery is not explained by missing measurements in EX1203 or EX1805. Both contain good soundings within a few metres of the truth and eligible frozen sample centers within about 18 m at small scales. Their failure is therefore a detector-selection miss under the frozen tail/candidate-cap logic. EX2102 is genuinely coverage/validity-limited locally.
development_implication: Cross-survey KUSTO needs a mechanism that can reward moderate but spatially consistent evidence across surveys instead of requiring each survey location to independently survive an extreme-tail top-candidate bottleneck.
epistemic_firewall: This diagnostic may motivate algorithm development, but Shark Rock is now calibration-only for any such change. Predictive improvement must be demonstrated on unseen data.
